## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its safety implications.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Chrome build succeeds
- [ ] Edge build succeeds
- [ ] Tests and fixtures contain synthetic data only
- [ ] No new permission, or the new permission is documented
- [ ] Final submission protection remains intact

## Site compatibility changes

If applicable, include the site/ATS name, test date, browser version, covered fields, and known limitations. Do not attach real resumes, tokens, cookies, or unredacted personal data.
